reviews.title: Can't connect two together end to end
reviews.review_text: These are quite pretty. They provide a nice soft glow. There's only one drawback, you can't connect them together end to end. I wanted to put these up on my sliding glass door in my eat in kitchen/family room and saw that I would need more than one to reach all the way across. So, I got two more and ended up not needing the third. Come to find out, there is no way to connect them together end to end like you can with Christmas lights, for example. So, I had to get two extension cords, connect the power ends together in the middle of the doors, and run the extension cord from the middle of my sliders down the side, and connect another extension cord to the first one in order to plug them into an outlet. (The fact that I had to use two extension cords isn't the fault of the product, it's because my sliders are very tall and I needed to avoid a doggy door that's next to them.) Other than that, they're still up on my doors and I plug them in every night to add a nice glow to add to the lights we use when watching tv or eating at the table.

reviews.title: curtain lights
reviews.review_text: love them but theres only about 5 strands that hang down, also the power cord to the actual lights is close together making it hard to put the lights up higher away from the outlet

reviews.title: Window lighting
reviews.review_text: Soft lighting. Lightweight. Do not remove tie tags until you hang first. Otherwise, they will tangle and can become difficult to separate. You may need an extension cord to meet up with your local outlet.
